把传内容这件事，做得简单一点。: Make the matter of transferring content simple.
常用的功能都在手边，打开就知道怎么用。: Commonly used functions are all at hand, and you will know how to use them as soon as you open them.
访问范围，说清楚。: The scope of access must be clearly stated.
名称就是入口，知道名称的人可以查看和修改。需要限制访问时，先设置密码。仅查看链接: The name is the entrance, and people who know the name can view and modify it. When you need to restrict access, set a password first. Just viewing the link is convenient for reading, but it does not mean that only the other party can view the content.
一段文字，一份代码，都有合适的样子。: A piece of text, a piece of code, has a suitable look.
复制来的常用格式可以保留。代码有自己的位置，缩进、换行也一起带过去。: Commonly copied formats can be retained. The code has its own location, and indentation and line breaks are also carried there.

保留缩进，按语言高亮，也能直接复制原文。: Keep indents, highlight by language, and copy the original text directly.
手边的内容，随时有地方放。: There is always a place to put the content at hand.
几件容易弄混的事。: A few things that can easily be confused.
换设备、发链接、关页面之前，先看清楚这些规则。: Before changing devices, sending links, or closing pages, read these rules clearly.
先了解保护的范围，再决定放什么、分享给谁。: First understand the scope of protection, and then decide what to put and who to share it with.
内容加密存储。知道剪贴板名称的人可以查看和修改。: Content is stored encrypted. People who know the clipboard name can view and modify it.
密码和解密所需的钥匙都留在浏览器里。换设备时，需要输入密码才能打开。: The password and the keys required for decryption are left in the browser. When changing devices, you need to enter a password to open it.
HTTPS 保护浏览器与服务器之间的传输。: HTTPS secures transmissions between the browser and the server.
使用新版密码保护时，浏览器通过 PBKDF2-SHA256 和 HKDF-SHA: When using the new version of password protection, the browser generates two separate pieces of data from the password via PBKDF2-SHA256 and HKDF-SHA256. One is used to AES-256-GCM encrypt and decrypt content, and the other is used to authenticate access to the server.
未设密码的剪贴板由服务器保存解密所需的钥匙。旧版密码保护仍按原有方式运行，重新设: For spaces without a password, the server holds the decryption key. Existing password protection keeps working as before. Set a new password to enable the newer protection.
顺手的话，也分享给朋友。: If you find it useful, share it with your friends.
把2Space的首页发给需要在设备间传文字的人。: Send the homepage of 2Space to people who need to transfer text between devices.
知道名称的人可以查看和修改；设置密码可限制访问。内容以加密形式保存在服务器，请勿: People who know the name can view and modify it; set a password to restrict access. Content is stored on the server in encrypted form, please do not store highly sensitive information. The original independent link retains its original access restrictions. Deletion cannot take back content that has been copied by others.
请勿存储或传播违法、侵权或有害内容。重要内容请自行备份；请合理使用，不要恶意刷量: Do not store or transmit illegal, infringing or harmful content. Please back up important content yourself; please use it rationally and do not maliciously use it.

浏览器把「18:30」加密成一串符号，再发送。: The browser encrypts “18:30” before sending it.
